correctness.rationale: PASS: For fixed d>=4, orthotope K=Π[-a_i,a_i] and motion-invariant affine-line measure, chord L>ell exactly corresponds (up to zero-measure boundaries) to projection of K∩(K-ell u) to u^perp. For b_i=2a_i-ell|u_i|>0, Cauchy projection formula gives F_ell(u)=Σ|u_i|Π_{j≠i} b_j. Normalize by Z=2^(d-1)(Πa_i)(Σa_i^-1) Γ(d/2)/(sqrt(pi)Γ((d+1)/2)). For ell=2A-ε, only 2^d body-diagonal directions contribute; tangent-coordinate perturbation u=(q+εv)/sqrt(1+ε²||v||²), v·q=0, has angular volume ε^(d-1), and all overlap widths scale ε, producing ε^(2d-2). After substituting w_i=a_i/(2A²)-v_i with Σa_iw_i=1/2, Dirichlet simplex integral yields C_d=2^(1-d)A^(d+1)Γ((d+1)/2)/(π^((d-1)/2)(2d-2)!(Πa_i)^3Σa_i^-1). Fixed diameter A: maximize (Πa_i)^2 e_{d-1}(a) by AM-GM/Maclaurin/Cauchy; only equal a_i saturate, so cubes uniquely minimize leading coefficient. d=4 unit cube C=1/(960π). Independent finite analytic constant/inequality checks passed 16 tests; asymptotic is proved by localization/dominated convergence, not Monte Carlo.
